title: Public history starts at 1.0.0; the AI-agent instruction moves to the root UPGRADING.md
question: D23 left open whether docs/upgrade.md 'From 0.7 to 1.0' ships in the public docs. How do CHANGELOG, docs and contributor files present history?

options.text: 1.0 is the first record: CHANGELOG.md keeps only [Unreleased] and then [1.0.0] (first public release; the 0.7.0 section and its compare links are removed); docs/upgrade.md and its sidebar/README links are removed from the docs site; the section 'From 0.7 to 1.0 (instructions for AI agents)' moves verbatim to the root UPGRADING.md (not in the docs site, not in the package archives); the 'From 0.3 to 0.7.0' section is deleted; MigrationGuideTest reads UPGRADING.md; RELEASING, DEVELOPMENT, CONTRIBUTING, ROADMAP, README, composer descriptions, consumer fixture and test fixtures speak of 1.0 only.
CHANGELOG starts at [1.0.0], but docs/upgrade.md with the 0.7 → 1.0 instruction stays a public page; the 0.3 → 0.7 section is deleted.
Keep the 0.7.0 and 0.3 history in CHANGELOG and docs.

context: P4 design session 2026-10-14; resolves the open consequence of D23. Owner answer M17: «1.0 — первая запись (Recommended)».
decision: A — 1.0 is the first record: CHANGELOG.md keeps only [Unreleased] and then [1.0.0] (first public release; the 0.7.0 section and its compare links are removed); docs/upgrade.md and its sidebar/README links are removed from the docs site; the section 'From 0.7 to 1.0 (instructions for AI agents)' moves verbatim to the root UPGRADING.md (not in the docs site, not in the package archives); the 'From 0.3 to 0.7.0' section is deleted; MigrationGuideTest reads UPGRADING.md; RELEASING, DEVELOPMENT, CONTRIBUTING, ROADMAP, README, composer descriptions, consumer fixture and test fixtures speak of 1.0 only.
rationale: Owner M17 chose the recommended option; 1.0 is the first public version (M16) and nothing should read as a continuation of 0.x.
consequences: Resolves D23's open question: the instruction does not ship in the public docs.
The CHANGELOG [1.0.0] section (P4.7) has no 'Fixed' list relative to an earlier version.
tests/Fixtures/Parity/*-0.7.0.json get neutral names; tests/Regression specs rename the field 'Defect in 0.3' to 'Original defect' (behavior assertions unchanged).
